ccc_local_wheat.title: Grain for the Storehouse
ccc_local_wheat.body: The storehouse is buying clean wheat while there is still room in the bins.

ccc_local_logs.title: Timber for Repairs
ccc_local_logs.body: Fences, roofs, and carts all need repairs. The builder is buying sound timber.

ccc_local_wool.title: Wool for the Loom
ccc_local_wool.body: The loom-house is short on clean wool. It is ordinary work, but useful work.

ccc_local_string.title: Cord and Canvas
ccc_local_string.body: Straps, sacks, and reins all seem to need repair at once. The caravan hands are buying string.

ccc_local_zombie.title: Keep the Road Clear
ccc_local_zombie.body: Travelers have been having trouble on the road after dusk. The watch is paying for help.

ccc_local_skeleton.title: Arrows in the Dark
ccc_local_skeleton.body: The watch has found too many stray arrows along the road and wants the problem reduced.

ccc_local_spider.title: Webs Near the Fields
ccc_local_spider.body: Too many webs have appeared near the fields. The farmers are paying for help before livestock wanders into them.
